Sam (People Ops): Quick alert 1: we're seeing a pileup of manager handbacks in EMEA due to rolling reviewer deadlines + two-day holiday window. Need an ops-safe way to extend handback window without breaking calibration deadlines.
Lina (Eng Manager): Yeah this bit us 1: several reviewers were OOO and I have 6 pending handbacks. If we push reviewer deadline it could push calibration by a week.
Carlos (Calibration Chair): Can calibration tolerate a soft window shift if we mark those pending as "handback-pending"? We need to be able to exclude them from strict median-response metrics.
Maya (IC): FWIW I submitted my self-review on time but my reviewer hasn't handed back. If theres a flag that shows "pending due to reviewer OOO" that would help my manager triage.
Sam (People Ops): Proposed operational steps: 1) Managers submit small CSV (manager_email, reviewee_email, form_id, reason_short, expected_handback_date) 2) People Ops runs a targeted "handback-extension" job that: a) tags the review record with extension metadata b) updates the per-team dashboard c) emits an audit event for compliance.
Lina (Eng Manager): CSV is fine. Can we have a quick template? Also what about the calibration packets snapshot? Will it include pre- or post-extension states?
Sam (People Ops): Template header:
```
manager_email,reviewee_email,form_id,reason_short,expected_handback_date
lina@redwood.ai,maya@redwood.ai,form_44512,reviewer OOO until 2026-04-03,2026-04-03
```
Sam (People Ops): Calibration snapshot: by default we'll bake in the "pre-extension" snapshot into the main packet and include an appendix of "post-extension" entries. Chairs can choose to include or exclude extended items during scoring.
Carlos (Calibration Chair): That works. Please ensure the appendix has the audit IDs for each reopened handback and the manager note. Also add a column for whether this affects promotion-eligible reviews.
Sam (People Ops): Noted. One more operational detail: to avoid double handbacks, the job will set a temporary submission lock on the review while manager is notified to re-open reviewer window. That prevents reviewers from accidentally re-submitting old attachments.
Maya (IC): Thanks 1: can you confirm that my submission timestamp remains the original? I don't want my on-time status to be overwritten.
Sam (People Ops): Your self-review timestamp is immutable. Only the reviewer handback window is extended and tagged. We'll surface both timestamps in the audit entry.
forms-bot: System: automatic deadline enforcement ran at 2026-03-29T23:59:00Z for EMEA region. 24 handbacks closed. People Ops manual extensions pending.
Lina (Eng Manager): Sending CSV now for 6 items. ETA for job?
Sam (People Ops): We'll run the job within 2 hours of receipt. Expect audit IDs in the response and an updated dashboard row per team.
Carlos (Calibration Chair): FYI chairs, please treat any item with flag "handback-extension" as "review-incomplete" in pre-calibration pass unless the appendix says otherwise.
Lina (Eng Manager): Got the audit IDs back: HBEXT-2211 through HBEXT-2216. Thanks all.
Maya (IC): Manager notified me and reviewer reopened. Handback just came in. :tada:
Sam (People Ops): Closing loop 1: I'll post the CSV template and a short how-to in the review ops doc page, and open a small UI request for a visible "handback status" badge next cycle.
